cookiesPage.title: Cookies and browser storage | {app}
cookiesPage.heading: Cookies & browser storage
cookiesPage.lead: FocusKept is built with privacy by default. We do not use third-party advertising cookies or cross-site tracking profiles.
cookiesPage.overviewText: We use only essential cookies by default to keep you securely signed in and remember your language preference. Functional browser storage is used strictly to store your interface settings such as color theme. If analytics is enabled, PostHog operates in a cookieless mode before consent, and optional usage metrics are sent only after you explicitly opt in.
cookiesPage.rowSessionPurpose: Maintains your secure signed-in session and authenticates API requests.
cookiesPage.rowLocalePurpose: Remembers your chosen language so you see translated pages consistently.
cookiesPage.rowThemePurpose: Stores your chosen interface color theme (light or dark) in your browser.
cookiesPage.rowAttrCookiePurpose: Functional first-touch attribution data (source, medium, campaign, referrer, landing page) without storing any personal identifier.
cookiesPage.rowConsentPurpose: Remembers whether you accepted or declined optional usage analytics.
cookiesPage.rowAnalyticsPurpose: When consent is granted, captures feature usage events to help us improve the app. Runs cookieless before consent.
cookiesPage.manageText: You can block or delete cookies at any time through your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies will prevent you from signing in to your FocusKept account.

accessibilityPage.title: Accessibility statement | {app}
accessibilityPage.heading: Accessibility statement
accessibilityPage.lead: FocusKept is designed to provide an inclusive, quiet, and structured focus environment for everyone, including neurodivergent individuals and people with disabilities.
accessibilityPage.standardText: We are committed to digital accessibility and aim to conform with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA standard.
accessibilityPage.featSemantic: Semantic HTML: Proper landmarks, heading hierarchy, and ARIA attributes for screen readers.
accessibilityPage.featContrast: High-contrast palette: Swimming lane-inspired themes calibrated to exceed WCAG AA contrast ratios in both light and dark modes.
accessibilityPage.featMotion: Reduced motion support: Strict adherence to prefers-reduced-motion preferences, disabling non-essential transitions and animations.
accessibilityPage.featKeyboard: Keyboard operability: Full keyboard navigation with visible focus rings on all interactive elements.
accessibilityPage.featTouch: Touch target sizing: Minimum 44×44px hit targets for buttons, inputs, and controls.
accessibilityPage.featTabular: Tabular numerals: Monospaced numeric alignment on timers, clocks, and stats to prevent visual jitter.
accessibilityPage.featQuiet: Low cognitive load: Calmed visual lanes, muted microphones during focus sets, and absence of unsolicited notification sounds.
accessibilityPage.limVideo: Live participant video: Because video is streamed peer-to-peer from participants' webcams, lighting conditions and background contrast depend on each individual user.
accessibilityPage.limWebRTC: Browser WebRTC compatibility: Some assistive technologies may experience varied behavior inside active WebRTC video elements depending on the browser engine.
accessibilityPage.feedbackText: If you experience any accessibility barriers or have suggestions for improvement, please contact us via our {contactLink} or email us at {email}. We welcome your feedback and aim to respond within 2 business days.

communityGuidelinesPage.title: Community guidelines | {app}
communityGuidelinesPage.heading: Community guidelines
communityGuidelinesPage.lead: FocusKept is a quiet, supportive space for focused work. These guidelines ensure every session is safe, respectful, and distraction-free.
communityGuidelinesPage.principleRespect: Mutual respect: Treat every focus partner with courtesy and kindness. People join from diverse backgrounds, neurotypes, and professions.
communityGuidelinesPage.principlePresence: Visual presence: Keep your camera turned on so your partner benefits from the body-doubling effect.
communityGuidelinesPage.principleQuiet: Quiet focus: Keep microphones muted throughout the main focus period to maintain deep concentration.
communityGuidelinesPage.cameraClothing: Clothing: Wear everyday casual clothing suitable for a public workspace or library.
communityGuidelinesPage.cameraWorkspace: Workspace: Set up your camera so your work area or face is visible, showing you are working.
communityGuidelinesPage.cameraEnvironment: Environment: Avoid distracting background activity, inappropriate artwork, or bright flashing lights.
communityGuidelinesPage.prohibitedNudity: Nudity, partial nudity, or sexually suggestive conduct of any kind.
communityGuidelinesPage.prohibitedHarassment: Harassment, hate speech, bullying, insults, stalking, or discriminatory remarks.
communityGuidelinesPage.prohibitedRecording: Recording, photographing, screenshotting, or distributing session video or audio of other members.
communityGuidelinesPage.prohibitedCommercial: Unsolicited sales pitches, recruiting, promotional links, or commercial solicitation.
communityGuidelinesPage.prohibitedDating: Flirting, romantic overtures, or inappropriate personal advances.
communityGuidelinesPage.safetyText: Your safety and comfort come first. If a partner violates these guidelines or makes you uncomfortable:
communityGuidelinesPage.safetyLeave: Leave immediately: You can exit any session at any time with no penalty.
communityGuidelinesPage.safetyReport: Report the partner: Submit a report describing what occurred. Submitting a report automatically blocks the person so you will never be matched with them again.
communityGuidelinesPage.safetyNoRecording: Note on video: Because sessions are never recorded, please provide specific details in your report.
communityGuidelinesPage.consequencesReview: Every report is reviewed by administrators. Minor infractions receive warnings.
communityGuidelinesPage.consequencesThreeReports: Automatic safety hold: Receiving 3 reports within a 30-day window automatically suspends an account pending manual investigation.
communityGuidelinesPage.consequencesZeroTolerance: Zero tolerance: Serious violations including nudity, harassment, or illegal content result in immediate, permanent account termination.
communityGuidelinesPage.questionsPrompt: Questions about our guidelines or a moderation decision? Contact {email}.
